entries.title: Matthew 15:1
segments: ¶Then the scribes and Pharisees who were from Jerusalem came to Jesus, saying,

entries.title: Matthew 15:2
segments: "Why do Your disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? For they do not wash their hands when they eat bread."

entries.title: Matthew 15:3
segments: He answered and said to them, "Why do you also transgress the commandment of God because of your tradition?

entries.title: Matthew 15:4
segments: "For God commanded, saying, 'Honor your father and your mother'; and, 'He who curses father or mother, let him be put to death.'

entries.title: Matthew 15:5
segments: "But you say, 'Whoever says to his father or mother, "Whatever profit you might have received from me [is] a gift [to God]" --

entries.title: Matthew 15:6
segments: 'then he need not honor his father or mother.' Thus you have made the commandment of God of no effect by your tradition.

entries.title: Matthew 15:7
segments: "Hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy about you, saying:

entries.title: Matthew 15:8
segments: 'These people draw near to Me with their mouth, And honor Me with [their] lips, But their heart is far from Me.

entries.title: Matthew 15:9
segments: And in vain they worship Me, Teaching [as] doctrines the commandments of men.'"

entries.title: Matthew 15:10
segments: ¶When He had called the multitude to [Himself], He said to them, "Hear and understand:

entries.title: Matthew 15:11
segments: "Not what goes into the mouth defiles a man; but what comes out of the mouth, this defiles a man."

entries.title: Matthew 15:12
segments: Then His disciples came and said to Him, "Do You know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?"

entries.title: Matthew 15:13
segments: But He answered and said, "Every plant which My heavenly Father has not planted will be uprooted.

entries.title: Matthew 15:14
segments: "Let them alone. They are blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind leads the blind, both will fall into a ditch."

entries.title: Matthew 15:15
segments: Then Peter answered and said to Him, "Explain this parable to us."

entries.title: Matthew 15:16
segments: So Jesus said, "Are you also still without understanding?

entries.title: Matthew 15:17
segments: "Do you not yet understand that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and is eliminated?

entries.title: Matthew 15:18
segments: "But those things which proceed out of the mouth come from the heart, and they defile a man.

entries.title: Matthew 15:19
segments: "For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies.

entries.title: Matthew 15:20
segments: "These are [the things] which defile a man, but to eat with unwashed hands does not defile a man."

entries.title: Matthew 15:21
segments: ¶Then Jesus went out from there and departed to the region of Tyre and Sidon.

entries.title: Matthew 15:22
segments: And behold, a woman of Canaan came from that region and cried out to Him, saying, "Have mercy on me, O Lord, Son of David! My daughter is severely demon-possessed."

entries.title: Matthew 15:23
segments: But He answered her not a word. And His disciples came and urged Him, saying, "Send her away, for she cries out after us."

entries.title: Matthew 15:24
segments: But He answered and said, "I was not sent except to the lost sheep of the house of Israel."

entries.title: Matthew 15:25
segments: Then she came and worshiped Him, saying, "Lord, help me!"

entries.title: Matthew 15:26
segments: But He answered and said, "It is not good to take the children's bread and throw [it] to the little dogs."

entries.title: Matthew 15:27
segments: And she said, "Yes, Lord, yet even the little dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters' table."

entries.title: Matthew 15:28
segments: Then Jesus answered and said to her, "O woman, great [is] your faith! Let it be to you as you desire." And her daughter was healed from that very hour.

entries.title: Matthew 15:29
segments: ¶Jesus departed from there, skirted the Sea of Galilee, and went up on the mountain and sat down there.

entries.title: Matthew 15:30
segments: Then great multitudes came to Him, having with them [the] lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others; and they laid them down at Jesus' feet, and He healed them.

entries.title: Matthew 15:31
segments: So the multitude marveled when they saw [the] mute speaking, [the] maimed made whole, [the] lame walking, and [the] blind seeing; and they glorified the God of Israel.

entries.title: Matthew 15:32
segments: Now Jesus called His disciples to [Himself] and said, "I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now continued with Me three days and have nothing to eat. And I do not want to send them away hungry, lest they faint on the way."

entries.title: Matthew 15:33
segments: Then His disciples said to Him, "Where could we get enough bread in the wilderness to fill such a great multitude?"

entries.title: Matthew 15:34
segments: Jesus said to them, "How many loaves do you have?" And they said, "Seven, and a few little fish."

entries.title: Matthew 15:35
segments: So He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

entries.title: Matthew 15:36
segments: And He took the seven loaves and the fish and gave thanks, broke [them] and gave [them] to His disciples; and the disciples [gave] to the multitude.

entries.title: Matthew 15:37
segments: So they all ate and were filled, and they took up seven large baskets full of the fragments that were left.

entries.title: Matthew 15:38
segments: Now those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.

entries.title: Matthew 15:39
segments: And He sent away the multitude, got into the boat, and came to the region of Magdala.
